{"reason":"Replace the medium/high alternative-supplier action with alert-planner. On 40 train events, this turns 34 switches plus 1 expedite into 35 timely alerts: cost falls from $2.165M to $1.225M and stockouts from 4 to 0, eliminating the medium/5.3 and medium/2.8 failures (projected fitness -1.225).","source":"(define (expedite-response risk-level inventory-days)
  (cond
    ((and (>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'high))
          (< inventory-days 5))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    ((>= (risk-rank risk-level) (risk-rank 'medium))
      (list 'alert-planner 'immediate-expedite-review))
    (else (list 'monitor))))"}
